description: This file defines an async function to make an API request to generate embeddings using OpenAI's API or a similar service. It handles request setup, error handling, and updating the UI with the embeddings.

methods.name: makeOpenAIEmbeddingsRequest
methods.description: Makes an asynchronous API call to obtain embeddings for a provided input string, updates the UI with the embeddings, and handles errors by notifying the user.
